papers.short_title: Value-filtered decoding

papers.summary: Safety steering with a calibrated budget for false interventions. The note separates oracle guarantees, learned values, finite sampling, and empirical evidence.

papers.short_title: Deep learning
papers.paper_title: Deep learning
papers.authors: Yann LeCun, Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton
papers.summary: Representation learning through gradients, spatial sharing and temporal sharing. Original derivations connect the mechanisms to evidence and limits.
papers.summary_zh: 从梯度、空间共享与时间共享理解表征学习。独立推导将机制与证据、适用边界连起来。

papers.short_title: AlexNet
papers.paper_title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Geoffrey E. Hinton
papers.summary: Convolutional learning at ImageNet scale. Architecture, optimization, regularization and evaluation costs explain the result and its limits.
papers.summary_zh: 从结构、优化、正则化与评估成本理解 ImageNet 规模上的卷积网络，区分单模型、集成与额外预训练的证据。

papers.short_title: Backpropagation
papers.paper_title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
papers.authors: David E. Rumelhart, Geoffrey E. Hinton, Ronald J. Williams
papers.summary: Hidden units receive a learning signal through the chain rule. Exact gradient derivations connect symmetry detection, distributed representations and recurrent weight sharing to their evidence and limits.
papers.summary_zh: 通过链式法则为隐藏单元建立学习信号。梯度推导把对称性检测、分布式表征与循环网络权重共享连到原始证据及其边界。

papers.short_title: Deep Learning, Chapter 1
papers.paper_title: Deep Learning
papers.authors: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
papers.summary: Chapter 1 only. Original derivations examine representation geometry, information loss, composition, depth conventions and learning costs. The rest of the book remains outside this note.
papers.summary_zh: 仅覆盖第1章，印刷页1至26。独立推导考察表征几何、信息损失、函数复合、深度口径与学习成本，书中其余章节不在本篇覆盖范围内。
papers.source_label: MIT Press (2016), Chapter 1: Introduction, pages 1 to 26

papers.short_title: Deep Learning, Chapter 2
papers.paper_title: Deep Learning
papers.authors: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
papers.summary: Chapter 2 only. Linear systems, norms, spectral geometry and the pseudoinverse lead to a complete PCA reconstruction argument. Worked arithmetic separates rank, approximation error and centering assumptions.
papers.summary_zh: 仅覆盖第2章，印刷页29至50。从线性系统、范数、谱几何与伪逆推导 PCA 重建目标，借独立算例区分秩、近似误差和中心化假设。
papers.source_label: MIT Press (2016), Chapter 2: Linear Algebra, pages 29 to 50

papers.short_title: Deep Learning, Chapter 3
papers.paper_title: Deep Learning
papers.authors: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
papers.reading_unit: Chapter 3: Probability and Information Theory, pages 51 to 77
papers.summary: Chapter 3 only. Probability identities, distribution assumptions and information measures are checked through worked derivations. Density transformations and graphical factorizations connect normalization to model structure.
papers.summary_zh: 仅覆盖第3章，印刷页51至77。通过独立推导与算例核对概率恒等式、分布条件和信息量，并用密度变换及图模型分解串联归一化与模型结构。
papers.source_label: MIT Press (2016), Chapter 3: Probability and Information Theory, pages 51 to 77

papers.short_title: Deep Learning, Chapter 4
papers.paper_title: Deep Learning
papers.authors: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
papers.summary: Chapter 4 only. Stable evaluation, conditioning and curvature connect gradient methods to constrained least squares. Worked derivations distinguish stationary points, valid KKT conditions and numerical guarantees.
papers.summary_zh: 仅覆盖第4章，印刷页78至95。从稳定求值、条件数与曲率串联梯度方法和约束最小二乘，通过独立推导区分驻点、有效的 KKT 条件与数值保证。
papers.source_label: MIT Press (2016), Chapter 4: Numerical Computation, pages 78 to 95

papers.short_title: Deep Learning, Chapter 5, Part 1
papers.paper_title: Deep Learning
papers.authors: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
papers.reading_unit: Chapter 5: Machine Learning Basics, introduction and Sections 5.1 to 5.3. Pages 96 to 119, the Section 5.3.1 prefix on page 120, and isolated Algorithm 5.1 on page 121.
papers.summary: The first part of Chapter 5. Learning tasks, capacity and regularization lead to a precise validation protocol. Independent derivations connect least squares, generalization gaps and cross validation to their assumptions.
papers.summary_zh: 第5章首个分节单元。从学习任务、容量与正则化推进到验证协议，通过独立推导串联最小二乘、泛化差距与交叉验证，并明确各自的假设。
papers.source_label: MIT Press (2016), Chapter 5, Sections 5.1 to 5.3 and Algorithm 5.1

papers.short_title: Deep Learning, Chapter 5, Part 2
papers.paper_title: Deep Learning
papers.authors: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville
papers.reading_unit: Chapter 5: Machine Learning Basics, Sections 5.4 to 5.6. From Section 5.4 on page 120 through the prefix before Section 5.7 on page 137. Floated Algorithm 5.1 on page 121 belongs to Part 1.
papers.summary: Sections 5.4 to 5.6 only. Estimation error connects bias, variance and consistency to likelihood and Bayesian inference. Original derivations distinguish finite sample guarantees, asymptotic conditions and posterior prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 仅覆盖第5.4至5.6节。从估计误差串联偏差、方差、一致性、似然与贝叶斯推断，通过独立推导区分有限样本保证、渐近条件与后验预测。
